# Review - PR 479 @ 8269f141edd2dc64d3313733bddfe81bd61ab7db

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 92b252ed4bb1860b12a0a6c96084512f53ae9e10. Six files, +93/-62 against the merge base `faf33cfe72c2ffc84a6e232c0f1078b40f7c5a11`: one new formalization-only finite-conditioning bound on the consistency defect, one new projective-measurement sum lemma, three deduplications onto declarations that already exist on main, and two docstring locator edits.

## Findings

- [ ] F1 (prose; changes) MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/Consistency.lean:97 - the docstring asserts more than the declaration proves: "The effects of a projective measurement are square-summable to the identity" states an equality, and that exact phrase documents the equality `sum_mul_conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_one` at `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Points/Closeness.lean:85`, whereas `sum_effect_conjTranspose_mul_self_le_one_of_projective` concludes only `∑ a, (M.effect a)ᴴ * M.effect a ≤ 1`. Fix: state the equality `∑ a, (M.effect a)ᴴ * M.effect a = 1` and name the lemma `sum_effect_conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_one_of_projective` (the current proof already establishes it - it is `le_of_eq` applied to a `calc` ending in `M.sum_eq_one`), or else reword the docstring to "bounded above by the identity".

## Review

Scope and head. The worktree HEAD equals the published head `8269f141edd2dc64d3313733bddfe81bd61ab7db`, so no divergent-head reading was needed. I read the full main-relative diff (`git diff faf33cfe72c2 8269f141edd2`) and the changed files in context. CI at this exact head is green: `local-ci/summary` success (1068s), with `local-ci/build`, `blueprint-sync`, `file-length`, `proof-debt`, `proof-evasion` and `paper-gaps` all success and `blueprint-render` / `statement-origin` skipped (no changes under their path filters).

Proof integrity. `rg` over all five touched Lean files finds no `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom` or `native_decide`. Nothing in the diff is a paper-labelled statement: the two new theorems are declared formalization-only auxiliaries in their docstrings, no blueprint node is claimed for either (`rg` over `blueprint/` finds neither name), and no existing statement, hypothesis set, quantifier order or error parameter is altered. Both new files elaborate: `lake env lean MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Lines/ConditionalConsistency.lean` and `.../Points/Consistency.lean` both returned clean in the PR worktree.

The new bound. `consistencyDefect_restrict_le_div_mass` (ConditionalConsistency.lean:36) unfolds `consistencyDefect` (Games/Consistency.lean:21, an `avgOver` of the off-diagonal overlaps) and discharges the goal with the pre-existing `avgOver_restrict_le_div_mass` (Games/RestrictedAverage.lean:25) plus the pre-existing `consistencyDefect_integrand_nonneg` (Lines/ConsistencyPositivity.lean:178). The mathematics is right and not vacuous: `Distribution.restrict` is the conditional distribution (pinned down by the `hmul` step of `avgOver_restrict_le_div_mass`), the integrand is nonnegative because the placed effects sit on opposite expanded registers, and the conclusion is the expected `defect / retained mass`. `hpos : 0 < ∑ question ∈ dist.support.filter good, dist.weight question` is a genuine boundary condition - it is what makes the conditional distribution and the division well defined - not a proof-obligation input; the docstring's claim that pointwise nonnegativity is derived rather than assumed is accurate. No A1-A6 anti-pattern: no conclusion-shaped hypothesis, no `:= rfl` sleight, no zero fallback, no default witness, no `*Statement` smuggle.

Reuse and deduplication. The three earlier duplicate-helper findings are resolved at this head and I confirmed each against main rather than taking the ledger's word: `ConsistencyPositivity.lean:125` and `:164` now call `ProjectiveSetting.place_comm` and `ProjectiveSetting.place_finsetSum` (`Points/PlacementSupport.lean:217` and `:140`), with the three private local copies deleted; `Points/Commutation.lean:319` now calls `applyOperatorToState_finset_sum` (`Test/MagicSquareTheorems/Rigidity/Consistency.lean:119`) and the local duplicate is gone. The new `Combining/Points/Commutation.lean -> Test/...` import direction has precedent (`Combining/Defs.lean`, `Combining/ErrorBounds.lean`, `Combining/Apply.lean` and others already import `MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.*`), and the full build is green, so no cycle. For the two new theorems I grepped main for an existing equivalent and found none - `sum_mul_conjTranspose_mul_self_eq_one` (Closeness.lean:87) is the two-measurement product form, not this one - so neither is a duplicate; F1 is about its wording, not its existence.

Style. Module docstrings with `## References` are present on the new file; file lengths are 71/215/449/430 lines, well inside the limit; naming is lowerCamelCase-per-Mathlib and paper-facing. The `SubLinePrefix.lean:22-23` locator addition checks out: `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:230-237` is exactly the definition of `L_DLine` labelled `eq:cl-dlnf`, which is the prefix restriction the module docstring describes.

Non-blocking notes, not findings. (a) Both new theorems currently have no consumer anywhere in `MIPStarRE/` - expected for a staged proof packet, and CONTRIBUTING section 5 item 7 asks only that new lemmas be reusable, which they are. (b) The substantive commit `6d004877 Add finite conditioning bound for consistency defects` does not use the `type(scope): short description` subject form the reviewer persona requires; the remaining non-merge commits do, and the local gate does not enforce it, so I am not blocking on branch history.

Not checked. I did not rerun the full `lake build` (the machine-wide build lock belongs to the gate; I relied on the green `local-ci/build` at this head), did not run `#print axioms` on the new declarations, and did not re-derive the paper's own conditioning step - the docstring locator `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:936-963` points at the pasting argument for `lem:qld-xz-lines` and is a "supporting" reference for a formalization-only estimate, consistent with the locator the pre-existing `Games/RestrictedAverage.lean:23-24` already carries, so I take it as adequate rather than verified line by line.

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED (code=APPROVED, prose=CHANGES_REQUESTED)

# Review - PR 503 @ 6addcf67cebd98fd364cc6553f17e10f8ca79f00

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 92b252ed4bb1860b12a0a6c96084512f53ae9e10. Documentation and policy only: 11 files, 213 insertions / 72 deletions against the merge base, moving the owner inbox to pinned issue #500, making it permissions-only, and reassigning project-outcome decisions to main; no Lean, blueprint or executable logic changed.

## Findings

- [ ] F1 (code; changes) local/protocols/issues-prs.md:309 - the absolute bar "changing the project goal is outside that authority" is rewritten to "main must not silently change the stated project goal", which converts a prohibition on main into a mere recording requirement: on the plain reading main may now redefine the stated project goal provided it writes the change down. This PR's own ledger entry (local/protocols/EVOLUTION.md:1062) grants main only workflow-budget overrides, consecutive workflow-only episodes and project-outcome decisions, and no other file at this head restates the bar (`git grep "project goal"` at head returns only AGENTS.md:198, a brief, and this line), so the guardrail is removed with nothing replacing it. Fix: restore the absolute form, e.g. "changing the stated project goal is outside main's authority and requires an owner decision on #500".
- [x] F2 (prose; minor) docs/paper-gaps/policy.tex:127 - `\texttt{DECISION B<n>: <letter>}` (and `\texttt{owner-inbox id=B<n>}` at :128, `\texttt{RESOLVED B<n>}` at :130) are the first `\texttt{...<...>}` uses in docs/paper-gaps; neither policy.tex nor the `\input{command}` preamble loads fontenc, so under the default OT1 encoding these normative literals typeset as `DECISION B¡n¿: ¡letter¿`. Nothing in local/bin/ci.sh compiles docs/paper-gaps to PDF, so the green paper-gaps step does not cover this. Fix: add `\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}` to docs/paper-gaps/command.tex, or write the placeholders as `\textless n\textgreater`.
- [x] F3 (code; minor) local/protocols/issues-prs.md:249 - "ids continue from B11" (repeated at AGENTS.md:700, local/DESIGN.md:114, local/personas/main.md:30, docs/paper-gaps/policy.tex:127) is now ambiguous: issue #500 comment 5599535765 already carries `### BLOCKER B11` with marker `<!-- owner-inbox id=B11 status=closed -->`, so a session reading this as "the next id is B11" would post a second, unrelated B11 (the existing marker does not contain the new `<!-- owner-inbox id=B11 -->` substring, so `ensure-pr-comment` would not adopt it). Fix: write "ids continue after B11, which is used; the next id is B12" in all five places.
- [x] F4 (prose; minor) docs/paper-gaps/policy.tex:116 - "Main decides and records mathematical nonconvergence and any required correction to a definition or game" states the definition/game authority without the two conditions its own cited governing section imposes at local/protocols/issues-prs.md:297-298 ("no change to the source semantics; definition or game corrections require an explicit faithfulness audit and independent mathematical review"). In the repository's faithfulness-policy document the sentence reads as unconditional. Fix: append ", with the source semantics preserved and subject to the faithfulness audit and independent mathematical review that Section 6 requires".

## Review

Scope: `git merge-base github/main 6addcf67` is `13409f63`; I read all 11 file diffs in full (.githooks/pre-commit, AGENTS.md, docs/paper-gaps/policy.tex, docs/paper-gaps/qpbt-gap-register.md, local/DESIGN.md, the main / mathfix / orchestrator personas, local/protocols/EVOLUTION.md, issues-prs.md, sessions.md). Trusted policy was read from github/main at 92b252ed: reviewer.md, prose-reviewer.md, review.md, and the AGENTS.md faithfulness and formatting sections.

Prior findings. All four earlier marked reviews were read. Round 1 F1 (owner-gated `MIPSTARRE_INFRA_OVERRIDE` contradicting the new boundary) is resolved: issues-prs.md:220-224, local/personas/main.md:198-200 and .githooks/pre-commit:29-32,67-68 now consistently require a recorded main decision, and the hook's `INFRA_CHANGED > 1000` guard itself is unchanged, so only the comments moved. Round 1 F2 (reply literal listing every option) is resolved: main.md:26-30 and the issues-prs.md:251-258 template both require one selected letter restricted to an offered alternative. Round 3 F1 (mutable status inside the lookup marker) is resolved and I verified it against the implementation rather than the prose: `gh_common.py:206` `ensure_pr_comment` builds the body with `_marked_body(marker, body)` and locates by the marker substring, so the immutable `<!-- owner-inbox id=B<n> -->` identity marker plus a separate `<!-- owner-inbox-status=... -->` body field does PATCH the one comment, and the instruction that BLOCKER.md must not repeat the identity marker is correct.

Content checked against live state: #500 exists, is open and titled as the v2 permissions-only inbox; #26 is titled "[archived 2026-09-09] Owner inbox v1 — superseded by #500", matching the archival statements at AGENTS.md:701, DESIGN.md:118, main.md:24, orchestrator.md:41, issues-prs.md:245, sessions.md:228 and policy.tex:130. The surviving #26 citations in docs/paper-gaps/qpbt-gap-register.md:27,43 are marked historical provenance, and EVOLUTION.md:297's older #26 line is a past ledger entry the new entry explicitly leaves unchanged. `results/telemetry/design-decisions.md` exists at head, so main.md:19-20's recording target is real. The head is two merges of github/main beyond the last reviewed head c4de7948; the main-relative diff shows no deletion of main content, so the merges are clean, and the only PR-owned content new since that review is the 2026-09-12 EVOLUTION entry at :1152-1164, which accurately describes the reconciliation it records.

Hygiene: `git diff --check` is clean, `sh -n` on the head's pre-commit hook passes, no added line exceeds the AGENTS.md 100-character limit, and the non-merge commit subjects use the `type(scope): short description` and `[codex-review-fix]` forms. Exact-head CI at 6addcf67: `local-ci/summary` success with all eight step contexts success; the aggregate commit state is failure only because of the stale `local-review/summary`, which is not mine to publish.

Not checked: no Lean, blueprint or paper statement changed, so faithfulness against references/qpbt-paper and `\lean`/`\leanok`/`\uses` accuracy are not at issue here; I ran no build and exercised no live GitHub mutation on #500; the prose lane is limited to the two docs/paper-gaps files, the only mathematical prose in the diff.

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED (code=CHANGES_REQUESTED, prose=APPROVED)

# Review - PR 481 @ 2b3800726984709fe3bb2d3a46a159cce3bed173

Independent review by a Claude Opus helper (owner-authorized 2026-09-17); no author, fixer or prior reviewer context reused. Trusted prompt, persona and policy ref: 92b252ed4bb1860b12a0a6c96084512f53ae9e10. Nine files, +1172/-102 against merge base 13409f63dea11a0e8a2f5d336215175448d4fccd: the retained `sorry` in the complex X-factor removal is discharged with a new complex Cauchy-Schwarz module, and the blueprint and paper-gap note are restated accordingly.

## Findings

- [ ] F1 (code; changes) MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Claims.lean:831 - `subline_replace_by_ordered_product` (:831) and `subline_Z_term_near_one` (:871) restate `subline_replace_by_ordered_product_re_direct` (:139) and `subline_Z_term_near_one_re_direct` (:748) verbatim and are proved by the bare terms `:= subline_replace_by_ordered_product_re_direct` / `:= subline_Z_term_near_one_re_direct`; `git grep` at this head finds no other reference to either name, so both are duplicate public declarations with no consumer (AGENTS.md "Use file-local helper lemmas only when they genuinely reduce duplication"; CONTRIBUTING §5.7). Fix: delete both and link the blueprint nodes to the existing `_re_direct` declarations.
- [ ] F2 (code; changes) MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Claims.lean:386 - the proof of `subline_remove_X_factor` (:366) repeats roughly 85 lines of the proof of `subline_remove_X_factor_direct` (:585): the same `μ`, `A`, `B`, `R`, `RB` definitions, the same `hprob`, the same five projectivity/commutation side goals, the same `hoverlap`, and the same six-step `calc` down to `Real.sqrt K * m * deltaLine ε ^ (1/2)`; the only difference is `abs_overlap_gap_le_sqrt_one_sub_of_isProj'` in place of `norm_overlap_gap_le_sqrt_one_sub_of_isProj`. Fix: factor the shared measurement setup and the `hoverlap`/`hdeficit` bound into one private lemma in `Claims.lean` and have both theorems apply it with their respective overlap-gap estimate.
- [ ] F3 (prose; changes) blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:2169 - five new support nodes re-link Lean declarations that already have a support node in this chapter, with `\leanok` on both sides: `lem:claim-17-1-direct-real` (:2169) vs `lem:claim-17-1-re-direct` (:1841); `def:combined-line-measurement` (:2187) vs `def:concrete-paired-line-measurement` (:1151); `lem:combined-line-measurement-x-marginal` (:2206) vs `lem:concrete-line-X-marginal` (:1868); `lem:concrete-x-overlap-deficit` (:2226) vs `lem:concrete-X-deficit-direct` (:1883); `lem:claim-17-3-direct-real` (:2286) vs `lem:claim-17-3-re-direct` (:1928). CONTRIBUTING §5.9 asks for one clearly subordinate support node per formalization-only declaration, and two certified nodes per name make the dependency graph double-count the same result. Fix: remove the five new nodes, moving any wording worth keeping (for example the `A_{ZX}`/`A_Z`/`A_Q` abbreviations) into the existing nodes, and retarget `\uses{...}` accordingly.
- [ ] F4 (prose; changes) blueprint/src/chapter/ch15_qpbt_combining.tex:846 - `lem:qld-4-10` (:803) now carries two `\leanok` proofs for the single declaration `exists_combinedPointsWitness`: the new one at :846, with the explicit envelope `12\eta+20C_1\sqrt\eps+16C_3\eps+4C_2\sqrt\eps` and `\eta=440[C_0(\eps+\sqrt\eps)]^{1/4}`, and the retitled "Alternative bound using a common error envelope" at :998, which states only that the estimates are absorbed into `\delta_Q(\eps)=K\eps^{1/8}`. At most one of the two describes the Lean proof, so one `\leanok` is inaccurate (prose criterion A.2). Fix: keep the proof that matches `exists_combinedPointsWitness` as the certified one and drop `\leanok` (and `\proves`/`\lean`) from the other, or delete the redundant proof.

## Review

Checked against the trusted policy read from `github/main` at 92b252ed: `local/personas/reviewer.md`, `local/personas/prose-reviewer.md`, `local/protocols/review.md`, `docs/CONTRIBUTING.md` §5 and the proof-integrity and Faithful Formalization sections of `AGENTS.md`. The worktree HEAD equals the published head 2b380072, so I read the diff and files at that sha.

Proof integrity. No `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom` or `native_decide` occurs in any of the six touched Lean files at this head; the PR removes the one `sorry` that was there, in `subline_remove_X_factor_direct`. That theorem's signature is untouched by the diff (the hunk replaces only the proof body), so nothing was weakened to make it pass. The new helper `norm_overlap_gap_le_sqrt_one_sub_of_isProj` (ComplexOverlapGap.lean:83) takes only projectivity, commutation, the factorization `CB = C * B`, a probability distribution and a unit state; it adds no conclusion-shaped hypothesis and no witness or bridge input, and its Cauchy-Schwarz route through the new `norm_weighted_sum_inner_le_sqrt_mul_sqrt` is the complex analogue of the existing real estimate in `OverlapGap.lean`. I re-elaborated `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/ComplexOverlapGap.lean` and `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining/Claims.lean` with `lake env lean` in the PR worktree; both returned rc 0 with no diagnostics.

Faithfulness. Paper Claim 17-2 (`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1168-1201`) bounds the difference between the `T \ot M^{Z} M^{X}` and `T \ot M^{Z}` averages by `m \delta_\Line^{1/2}`, with `T` the X-Z-X sandwich of lines 942-949; the proved Lean conclusion carries the same ordering, the same placements `AA'` / `BA''`, and the same error `C m \delta_\Line^{1/2}` obtained as the square root of the `K m^2 \delta_\Line` deficit, matching the paper's own `O(m^2 \delta_\Line)` step. The remaining scope restriction is the carrier: the statement quantifies over `SubLineWitness`, the directly indexed law, not the source law `D`. That restriction is recorded correctly - `lem:claim-17-1` (:1954), `lem:claim-17-2` (:2010), `lem:claim-17-3` (:2083) and `lem:qld-sublines` (:1464) all keep `\notready` with no `\lean` or `\leanok`, and the `\lean{SubLineWitness, exists_subLineWitness}` link is moved off `lem:qld-sublines` onto the new, explicitly formalization-only `lem:qld-sublines-direct` (:1675). The paper-gap note reclassifies the scalar step from obligation to proved result and keeps the transport and the `combined_line_measurement_consistency` obligation open. That is the disposition the Faithful Formalization Policy asks for.

Prior findings. Round 3 (review 5151636969 @ c738dfbc) left two open. Code F1, the duplicated uniform-point proof and the `_current` helpers: resolved - `git grep _current` under `MIPStarRE/QPBT/Combining` returns nothing at this head, `UniformLinePoint.lean` drops `extendedFinCombineEquiv`, `extendedPointBlocksEquiv` and `uniformDistribution_map_projX_projZ_pauli_current` and now imports `Lines/SubLineTransport` to use the public `uniformDistribution_map_projX_projZ_pauli`. Prose F1, one-based paper indices against zero-based Lean indices: resolved - `lem:qld-sublines-direct` now states the `i` to `i-1` identification for `Fin n`, the unit vectors and the restricted law. Rounds 1 and 2 findings were reported resolved at round 3 and I re-checked the load-bearing ones (source-claim certification, the `SubLineWitness` link, the prefix/Parseval/fiber wording, the placement-module header, which now cites the chapter file without a line range). F2-F4 above are new duplication introduced on top of those repairs, of the same kind the earlier rounds blocked on.

Exact-head CI: all nine `local-ci/*` contexts are success at 2b380072 (`local-ci/summary`: "all gating steps passed (350s)"). The only failing context is `local-review/summary` ("code reviewer exited 143 with no review"), which this review feeds.

Not checked: I did not run a full `lake build`, `leanblueprint web` or `lake exe checkdecls` (the build lock is machine-wide and CI already covers them at this head); I did not verify the numeric constants quoted in the two `lem:qld-4-10` proofs against the Lean construction, which is why F4 says one of them is wrong rather than which; and I did not re-derive the transport claims the gap note leaves open.

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED (code=CHANGES_REQUESTED, prose=CHANGES_REQUESTED)
